spans.s:
जि {c1c} P. (Atm. when preceded,
by परा and वि) (जयति, जिगाय जिग्ये
अजैषीत्-अजेष्ट, जेतुं, जित)
1 To conquer,
defeat, overcome, vanquish,
subjugate; जयति तुलामधिरूढो भास्वानपि
जलदपटलानि

.
--2 To surpass, excel;
[]
गर्जितानंतरां वृष्टिं सौभाग्येन जिगाय सा

; Ghaṭ. 22;
Śi. 1. 19.
--3 To win (by conquest, in
gambling or in a law-suit), acquire
by conquest; प्रागजीयत घृणा ततो
मही

.
--4 To curb, restrain,
control, conquer (as passions).
--5 To be victorious, be supreme or
pre-eminent (generally used in
benedictory stanzas or salutations);
जयतु जयतु महाराजः (in dramas).
स जयति परिणद्धः शक्तिभिः शक्तिनाथः

.
--6 To convict.
--7 To overcome or
get the better of (as a disease &c.).
--8 To expect from (with abl.).
--Caus. (जापयति) To cause to win
or conquer. --Desid. (जिगीषति)
To wish to win, acquire or excel,
to vie with, emulate, to seek for;
चलति नयान्न जिगीषतां हि चेतः
